frozen_reference: PLLR matched development A0, no retraining
stage_bounds: left inclusive, right exclusive; actual center coordinates
token_validity: finite actual time and all nine features; unique sorted centers; full 2-s window within source metadata valid range; no interpolation
provenance: source feature metadata and annotation-relative coordinates only; no independent EDF onset replay
relative_reference: valid simultaneous channel median / (1.4826*MAD + 1e-8); scale<=1e-8 uses1; clip [-8,8]
temporal_standardization: population mean/std over valid FIT tokens only; std<=1e-8 uses1; invalid tokens masked zero after transform
time_embedding: 16 fixed sin/cos coordinates using actual seconds and exp(-log10000*arange(0,16,2)/16), then learned Linear16x16
wrapper: post-residual LayerNorm16; FFN16-32-GELU-dropout-16-dropout; post-residual LayerNorm16, official EncoderLayer topology
pooling: stage masked mean16; cross-seizure stage-wise masked mean/std (population); flatten 48+48=96; missing stage zero
residual_eligibility: at least one seizure has >=2 valid early windows for canonical channel
A0_OOF: four original PR-UAS inner patient groups, queried patient excluded from teacher train and selection; reused hash-verified teachers, deterministic eval logits
training_seed: 42+1009*fold; identical T1/T2 state and training reseed
objective: one patient channel-mean update; hard-label BCE pos_weight=FIT EZcount/NEZcount
bootstrap: 10000 paired patient-ID cluster draws, seed42, preserve repeated validation appearances
saturation_definition: abs(delta)>=0.49; severe if >10% of valid validation channels
